text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
My business here is finished. I will be 
heading back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... heh. How was that, 
Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Did I grow properly? At the full speed I'm 
capable of right now.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yay♪ That's Maya for you, wouldn't 
you say?☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. I'm not clumsy enough to get caught 
in the slipstream of other girls♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Alright! The next objective has already 
been acquired! The target is—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm going full speed ahead for 
the next one too~♪
